effect: Opening a screen no longer changes which countries count as bloc poles. The four poles (UAB) were cached for 365 days from whoever asked first. The Inspector and Diplomacy views ask through _blocOf, and the tick asks when deciding who may join a war (alQ -> wlQ -> owA, where role "pole" makes a country eligible), so opening a screen set the date the list was taken and the date it next refreshed; a reload also restarted the year because the cache is not saved. The list is sorted by live GDP, so a different date can give different poles and a different war-join decision. The patch keeps the list only for the same game day, so it is a pure function of that day's state. Views run only between days (viewSnapshot and domainCall settle the pending day first, subscribeView and status skip view building while a day runs, and GLA restores the published day on each yield), and the tick reads after its own day++, so a view's list never reaches the tick. Expected effect: the AI's war joins and military-support decisions (dwQ, fwQ, through owA) read the same list with or without screens opened and across a reload; poles follow GDP ranks rather than running up to a year late, which can change both near a rank boundary. Known limit: reads on the same game day share one list. The tick is not exposed, because it reads after its own day++; if a player command reads the poles (not confirmed), it could see a list from earlier that day. That window was a year and is now a day; closing it would mean rebuilding the list on every read, which the Diplomacy view does per country. Day 0 unchanged: the list is computed from the same state. No new state. (Minified names in this text are those of build 26403824; the patch's find text has the current ones.)
